extDescription.message: Send E(x)Hentai galleries to your MangaCouch download queue.

keyHint.message: Create a key in Settings → Access & connections → API keys with the “Browser extension” permission.

statusConnected.message: Connected. The API key “$LABEL$” is valid ($KIND$).

statusSavedPermissionKept.message: Saved, but the old library permission could not be removed. Remove it in the browser's extension permissions.

errorOrigin.message: Enter the library origin without a page path, for example http://localhost:8780.

errorPermissionMissing.message: Save Settings again to grant library access.

errorKeyRejected.message: The API key is invalid or revoked.

errorKeyReadOnly.message: This key is read-only. Create a key in Settings → Access & connections → API keys with the “Browser extension” permission.

statusAdded.message: Added to downloads. Confirm any cost or download quality in the Downloads page.

statusRequeued.message: Queued again. Follow it in Downloads.

statusExisting.message: Already in Downloads; follow or continue it there.

statusDownloaded.message: Already downloaded; the book is in the library. Use Download again under History in Downloads to fetch it again.

errorPublicOrigin.message: Use the public address configured on the MangaCouch server.

errorTimeout.message: The library did not respond within 15 seconds. Check its connection and try again.
